August 23 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 01)

This archival dispatch initiates the sequential archival walk for August 23rd, documenting the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on August 23 across American and British broadcasting history (1943–1986):
